sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT KEP_SEQ, BUYER, BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T' AND BUYER = 'KRLOTTG004' AND BUYER_ITEM_NO NOT LIKE 'NO_CODE%' ORDER BY KEP_SEQ ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100

SELECT KEP_SEQ AS IF_SEQ, STATUS, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME, CASE WHEN BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE 'NO_CODE%' THEN ' ' ELSE BUYER_ITEM_NO END BUYER_ITEM_NO, PLANT, DELIVERY_LT, MIN_ORDER_QTY AS MOQ_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY, PRC_UNIT_QTY AS UNIT_QTY, UNIT_MEASURE, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, ' ' AS KEY_1, ' ' AS KEY_2, ' ' AS KEY_3, ' ' AS KEY_4, ' ' AS KEY_5, ' ' AS KEY_6, ' ' AS KEY_7, ' ' AS KEY_8, ' ' AS KEY_9, ' ' AS KEY_10 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE KEP_SEQ = #KEP_SEQ# AND IF_FLAG = 'T'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_MSG = 'Item Price : ' || #IF_MSG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE KEP_SEQ = #KEP_SEQ#
